reasons: Interaction signal is essentially absent: 2 of 115 Dialog-linked actors (1.7%) have any non-Dialog participation row, and no non-Dialog surface contains two of them. A model fed only the ledger could not distinguish listed from unlisted people except via Clifford himself (the spine) and Driscoll.

The 'answer' is ill-defined: directory listing mixes active members, guests, speakers and past guests (master doc Part 17); 222 Airtable registrations are not attendance; repo holds no attended ledger. Target must be fixed (listed vs registered vs attended) before any prediction.

The ground-truth list is already public in the repo and in the ledger, so any run now is post hoc / fitted, not blind. Most inputs the owner would use (Thiel/Founders Fund/Palantir/Detachment 201/EF/Anduril interactions) were gathered by people who had already seen the Dialog list; selection of what to ingest was not independent of it.

No role denominators exist: no PAS/appointee roster, no per-role eligible pool, no baseline selector. The only cohort is 8 US presidents (officeholder-cohort.md); the OGE-278 appointee track is a scaffold with every row not_searched.

The repo's own validators and policy forbid using listing as interaction (surface_not_hop_eligible, forbidden inferences, K0 note 'must not use Dialog co-listing as causal evidence'). A reproduction test would have to live outside the hop graph as graph-inert analysis.
what_a_blind_test_would_need: Freeze the target before scoring: exact set (e.g. the 112 listed_in_directory slugs, optionally the 3 officers), as-of date 2026-06-16, and what counts as hit. Hash the file; do not let the model or feature builder read it.

Define the candidate universe independently of the answer: e.g. all named persons on a stated role-neutral frame (Senate, cabinet and sub-cabinet PAS, UK ministers, FTSE/Fortune CEOs, Forbes lists, think-tank chairs) with source and date. The ratio listed/universe is the base rate.

Build features only from interaction sources dated before 2026-06-16 and collected by a different pass than the Dialog import (co-board, co-investor, same-event rosters, LDA, FEC, SEC Form D, Companies House, Detachment 201-type rosters). Record collection timestamps and who knew the list.

Pre-register the method and predicted-set size k (or score threshold) before unblinding; report precision@k, recall, AUC and lift against a null: random draw from the universe, role-count-matched draw, and a naive prominence/status-only baseline. Permutation test for significance.
Hold out by seed: predict the 112 from a subset of seeds (e.g. Thiel+Hoffman+Grinberg only), not from names of listed people. Include leave-one-role-out.

For the 'any government role narrows to a handful' claim: pick roles with known outcomes AFTER the freeze date (future appointments or confirmations), predict the shortlist of size k, then score containment of the actual appointee and the size of k relative to the universe. Retrospective roles only count if the prediction code was frozen before the pool was assembled.
Independent second-party review of the frozen file, universe and code (repo's own standard: second-party adjudication count is 0 and AI red-team cannot clear).
